campaign: XC330 Real-Position v2, 98 g fixture family
fixture_definition: One 0.006 kg link plus two pins of 0.004 kg and two payloads of 0.042 kg; 0.098 kg total for B0/B1/B2/G1. M0 has no added moving fixture.

controller.input_boundary: recorded internal Position Trajectory and Velocity Trajectory
controller.external_goal_role: preserved for comparison; not replay input
controller.mapping_status: fixed engineering conversion; no controller gains fitted; not independently verified shaft torque

replay_initialization: Each episode starts at its first processed physical position and velocity; internal references held at preceding 10 ms sample over five 2 ms simulation substeps.
scoring: All samples of the active-profile cropped and interpolated episode; no additional mask, filtering, time shift, alignment optimization or burn-in exclusion.
model_difference_from_Class03: This campaign uses 6 g link + two 46 g pin/payload assemblies (98 g), whereas the reviewed Class03 presentation uses 22 g link + two 44 g assemblies (110 g). Fixture labels are local identifiers and do not establish matching mass properties. Class03 illustrative torque channel and earlier Class02 stall-based teaching bounds are not the fixed Mode5 engineering controller used here.
fitting_scope: Published frozen candidates only; no refitting in this export. Calibration M0/B0/B1/B2 under H1/H2; P04/P05 model-selection; P06/P07 held out. H1 and H2 have separate effective joint parameter vectors.
